name: start_recording
title: Start recording
description: Start recording a new meeting and create its session bundle. The screen, the microphone and the system audio are captured as separate track files (the first layer of speaker separation). Only one recording can run at a time. `profile` names a saved profile (see list_profiles / set_profile) applied as defaults for config, scope, engagement and automatic export destinations — explicit arguments and config keys win; omitted = the default profile. `request_id` is the client-generated idempotency key: repeating the call with the same request_id returns the original result instead of starting a second recording. Returns the new meeting_id, the absolute bundle path and the track files (relative to the bundle). On failure returns an error_envelope (isError=true) with code: busy (a recording is already running), recorder_unavailable (narumi-recorder binary missing, or screen / microphone permission denied), policy_violation (`config` selects an engine or provider not allowed by its external_send_policy — nothing is silently substituted), engine_unavailable (`config` names an engine / provider not registered on this server), invalid_argument (unknown profile, bad config), internal.

meeting_name.description: Human-readable meeting name. When omitted the server uses "会議 <timestamp>" (local start time).

engagement.description: Optional engagement / project / customer label used for grouping and search.

scope.description: Affiliation scope (confidentiality boundary) of the meeting. Omit for an unscoped meeting. Scoped meetings are only visible to list_meetings / get_meeting calls that pass the same scope.

profile.description: Saved profile name (see list_profiles / set_profile) whose config, scope, engagement and export_destinations are applied as defaults; explicit arguments and config keys win. Omitted = the profile marked is_default (the built-in "default" profile is local-only Whisper, no diarization, plain minutes).

config.description: Per-meeting processing config overrides. Omitted keys take the profile defaults. Can be changed later with set_meeting_config.

started_at.description: UTC time the recorder reported that capture began.

bundle_path.description: Absolute path of the session bundle directory (<NARUMI_HOME>/meetings/<meeting_id>).

tracks.description: Track name (screen / mic / system) → file path relative to bundle_path (e.g. tracks/mic.m4a).
